effects.label: Burn
effects.description: Damages the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the debuff. Creates a Damage Zone around the recipient, damaging any of their allies in the indicated radius by a percentage of their MAX HP every tick.The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This debuff can be stacked.

levels.text:
Selects 1 enemy up to 14m away. Attacks the 9 enemies with the lowest HP% in a 7m radius around the target, from a distance of 9m, 2 times, dealing 98 damage per hit. Each hit casts a [1% Burn] debuff on the targets, lasting 6s. The [Burn] ticks every 2s, damaging targets by 1% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 200% ATK). Also damages all of the target's allies in a 6m radius by 0.5% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 200% ATK).
Accuracy required for: Burn

bio: Hear Ricklow's name and be afraid, villains! For his soul burns with an awesome power! Within his Arcana, the Pyro Librum, he writes your final words. And they read... BURN! If you can't tell, Ricklow is a Magi with a flair for the dramatic, casting himself as Amara's greatest pyromancer and the hero that will free it from Malice's grasp. He and Skrimp get on famously.
